task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Duplicate Items' collection in the Zotero sidebar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Duplicate Items' folder is selected/highlighted in the left-hand pane of Zotero.

task_completion.description: Merge 'Attention Is All You Need' duplicates while preserving Volume '30'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent selects the duplicate pair for 'Attention Is All You Need' and clicks 'Merge Items' in the right pane, ensuring the version with Volume '30' is the master or the field is selected.

task_completion.description: Merge 'Deep Learning' duplicates while preserving DOI '10.1038/nature14539'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent selects the 'Deep Learning' duplicates and merges them, ensuring the DOI field shows '10.1038/nature14539' in the final item.

task_completion.description: Merge 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' duplicates while preserving Pages '379-423'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent selects the duplicates for this paper and merges them, ensuring the Pages field is set to '379-423'.

task_completion.description: Merge 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' duplicates while preserving Year '1950'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent selects the duplicates for this paper and merges them, ensuring the Date/Year field is set to '1950'.

task_completion.description: Verify the 'Duplicate Items' view is empty after all merges.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The center pane of the Zotero window shows 'No items to display' or is empty when 'Duplicate Items' is selected.

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI to perform merges rather than external scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Zotero 'Merge Items' button and metadata panes.

integrity.description: The agent merged items rather than manually typing in the metadata values into a single item and deleting the other.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Merge X Items' button is visible and clicked in the right-hand sidebar during the process.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Zotero application interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Zotero 7 interface (sidebar, item list, and info pane) is clearly visible and active in the screenshots.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The library starts with 22 items and 4 pairs of duplicates. After merging, the total item count in 'My Library' should be 18. Specific metadata to verify: 'Attention Is All You Need' must have Volume 30; 'Deep Learning' must have DOI 10.1038/nature14539; 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' must have Pages 379-423; 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' must have Year 1950. The 'Duplicate Items' view must be empty at the end.
